lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਘਰੀ ਬਹਾਲਿਅਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhagataa no dei ana(n)d thir gharee bahaalian ||
lines.translation: The Lord bestows bliss upon His devotees, and gives them a seat in the eternal home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੀਆ ਨੋ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰਿ ਚਾਲਿਅਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: paapeeaa no na deee thir rahan chun narak ghor chaalian ||
lines.translation: He does not give the sinners any stability or place of rest; He consigns them to the depths of hell.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਗੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: har bhagataa no dei piaar kar a(n)g nisataarian ||19||
lines.translation: The Lord blesses His devotees with His Love; He sides with them and saves them. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਡੂਮਣੀ ਕੁਦਇਆ ਕਸਾਇਣਿ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਘਟ ਚੂਹੜੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਚੰਡਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kubudh doomanee kudaiaa kasaain par ni(n)daa ghat choohaRee muthee krodh cha(n)daal ||
lines.translation: False-mindedness is the drummer-woman; cruelty is the butcheress; slander of others in one's heart is the cleaning-woman, and deceitful anger is the outcast-woman.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰੀ ਕਢੀ ਕਿਆ ਥੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਚਾਰੇ ਬੈਠੀਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaree kadhee kiaa theeai jaa(n) chaare baitheeaa naal ||
lines.translation: What good are the ceremonial lines drawn around your kitchen, when these four are seated there with you?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰਾਂ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਨਾਉ ਜਪੇਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sa(n)jam karanee kaaraa(n) naavan naau japehee ||
lines.translation: Make Truth your self-discipline, and make good deeds the lines you draw; make chanting the Name your cleansing bath.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗੈ ਊਤਮ ਸੇਈ ਜਿ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਪੰਦਿ ਨ ਦੇਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak agai ootam seee j paapaa(n) pa(n)d na dehee ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who do not walk in the ways of sin, shall be exalted in the world hereafter. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa ha(n)s kiaa bagulaa jaa kau nadar karei ||
lines.translation: Which is the swan, and which is the crane? It is only by His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਾਗਹੁ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa kaagahu ha(n)s karei ||2||
lines.translation: Whoever is pleasing to Him, O Nanak, is transformed from a crow into a swan. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ਕੰਮੁ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਆਖੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: keetaa loReeai ka(n)m s har pahi aakheeai ||
lines.translation: Whatever work you wish to accomplish-tell it to the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaraj dei savaar satigur sach saakheeai ||
lines.translation: He will resolve your affairs; the True Guru gives His Guarantee of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)taa sa(n)g nidhaan a(n)mrit chaakheeai ||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, you shall taste the treasure of the Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai bha(n)jan miharavaan daas kee raakheeai ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the Merciful Destroyer of fear; He preserves and protects His slaves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਲਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਖੀਐ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har gun gaai alakh prabh laakheeai ||20||
lines.translation: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and see the Unseen Lord God. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tis kaa sabhasai dei adhaar ||
lines.translation: Body and soul, all belong to Him. He gives His Support to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh seveeai sadaa sadaa daataar ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, become Gurmukh and serve Him, who is forever and ever the Giver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau balihaaree tin kau jin dhiaaiaa har nira(n)kaar ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Formless Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਉਜਲੇ ਓਨਾ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: onaa ke mukh sad ujale onaa no sabh jagat kare namasakaar ||1||
lines.translation: Their faces are forever radiant, and the whole world bows in reverence to them. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਉਲਟੀ ਭਈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਖਰਚਿਉ ਖਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur miliai ulatee bhaee nav nidh kharachiu khaau ||
lines.translation: Meeting the True Guru, I am totally transformed; I have obtained the nine treasures to use and consume.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠਾਰਹ ਸਿਧੀ ਪਿਛੈ ਲਗੀਆ ਫਿਰਨਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: athaarah sidhee pichhai lageeaa phiran nij ghar vasai nij thaai ||
lines.translation: The Siddhis-the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers-follow in my footsteps; I dwell in my own home, within my own self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ ਸਦ ਵਜਦੇ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anahad dhunee sad vajade unaman har liv laai ||
lines.translation: The Unstruck Melody constantly vibrates within; my mind is exalted and uplifted-I am lovingly absorbed in the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har bhagat tinaa kai man vasai jin masatak likhiaa dhur paai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, devotion to the Lord abides within the minds of those who have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau dhaadhee har prabh khasam kaa har kai dar aaiaa ||
lines.translation: I am a minstrel of the Lord God, my Lord and Master; I have come to the Lord's Door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਪੂਕਾਰ ਢਾਢੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har a(n)dar sunee pookaar dhaadhee mukh laaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord has heard my sad cries from within; He has called me, His minstrel, into His Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪੁਛਿਆ ਢਾਢੀ ਸਦਿ ਕੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਅਰਥਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har puchhiaa dhaadhee sad kai kit arath too(n) aaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord called His minstrel in, and asked, "Why have you come here?"

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit devahu daan daiaal prabh har naam dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: "O Merciful God, please grant me the gift of continual meditation on the Lord's Name."

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪੈਨਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
lines.transliteration: har daatai har naam japaaiaa naanak painaaiaa ||21||1|| sudh
lines.translation: And so the Lord, the Great Giver, inspired Nanak to chant the Lord's Name, and blessed him with robes of honor. ||21||1||Sudh||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ॥ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag kabeer jeeu kaa || ek suaan kai ghar gaavanaa ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Kabeer Jee: To Be Sung To The Tune Of "Ayk Su-Aan" :

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਨੀ ਜਾਨਤ ਸੁਤੁ ਬਡਾ ਹੋਤੁ ਹੈ ਇਤਨਾ ਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨ ਅਵਧ ਘਟਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jananee jaanat sut badaa hot hai itanaa k na jaanai j din din avadh ghatat hai ||
lines.translation: The mother thinks that her son is growing up; she does not understand that, day by day, his life is diminishing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਕਰਿ ਅਧਿਕ ਲਾਡੁ ਧਰਿ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਜਮਰਾਉ ਹਸੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mor mor kar adhik laad dhar pekhat hee jamaraau hasai ||1||
lines.translation: Calling him, "Mine, mine", she fondles him lovingly, while the Messenger of Death looks on and laughs. ||1||
